findings.description: The RDS instance sets publicly_accessible = true, giving it a public IP and exposing the MySQL endpoint to the internet, greatly expanding attack surface for credential brute-force or exploitation.
storage_encrypted = false means the database volumes and snapshots are stored unencrypted, so anyone obtaining the underlying storage or a snapshot can read all data.

The master username is hardcoded to the well-known 'admin' and the password is supplied via a plain Terraform variable (var.password) rather than a secrets manager, so the credential lands in state files and plan output.

findings.issue_category: missing TLS enforcement in parameter group
findings.description: The instance uses a parameter group that does not set require_secure_transport = 1, so unencrypted MySQL connections to the (publicly accessible) database are permitted.

The database password (var.password) is interpolated into EC2 user_data, which is stored in plaintext in Terraform state and readable by any process or user on the instance via the instance metadata service (http://169.254.169.254/latest/user-data).

No metadata_options block requiring http_tokens = "required" is set, so IMDSv1 remains enabled; combined with the credential-bearing user_data and a broad instance profile, an SSRF in the PHP app would leak the DB password and IAM role credentials.
No root_block_device with encrypted = true is specified, so the instance's root volume (which holds the plaintext dbinfo.inc credentials file) may be stored unencrypted.

The instance role grants s3:*, ec2:*, and rds:* on Resource "*", allowing a compromised web server to read or destroy any bucket, launch/terminate instances, and modify or snapshot any database in the account.
Egress allows all protocols to 0.0.0.0/0 from the database security group, enabling data exfiltration or command-and-control traffic from a compromised database host.
The database security group permits port 3306 from the entire VPC CIDR rather than only the application security group; any instance in the VPC can reach the database directly.

skip_final_snapshot = true combined with backup_retention_period = 0 disables all recovery points; while partly operational, it also removes the ability to forensically recover data after a destructive compromise.
